selection: Use the first numeric utterance of each of the 30 speakers in existing s1_candidate_v1 for test-clean. For dev-clean and dev-other use separately frozen 30-speaker, one-utterance policies. No algorithm scores used. Reject overlapping speakers or source hashes across all 90 records, and any overlap with development/tuning speakers or hashes.
scene_assembly: Within each subset, numeric speaker order, consecutive triples, angles -45/0/50 degrees, first 10 seconds. Ten scenes per subset, thirty total. No speaker or recording reuse.
statistical_scope: Speaker-disjoint simulated scenes conditional on one English read-speech corpus. Report each subset separately; this is not universal acoustic or population independence.
